## Making the Loop

```{r loop}
departments = c("Accountancy", "Economics", "Entrepreneurship", "Finance", "Information_Systems_and_Analytics", "Marketing", "Management"
)

fsb_df = data.frame()

for (department in departments) {
  directory_url = paste0(
    "https://miamioh.edu/fsb/directory/?up=/query/all/all/",
    department,
    "/all"
  )
  webpage = rvest::read_html(directory_url)

  rows = webpage |>
    rvest::html_elements("tr")
  
  person_rows = rows[-1]

  names = person_rows |>
    rvest::html_element("strong a") |>
    rvest::html_text()

  positions = person_rows |>
    rvest::html_element("i") |>
    rvest::html_text2()

  websites = person_rows |>
    rvest::html_element("strong a") |>
    rvest::html_attr("href")

  df = data.frame(
    department = department,
    name = names,
    position = positions,
    website = websites
  )

  fsb_df = rbind(fsb_df, df)
}

fsb_df$department[fsb_df$department == "Information_Systems_and_Analytics"] = "ISA"

head(fsb_df)

unique(fsb_df$department)

nrow(fsb_df)
```
